about: Answer-revealing regions per figure and the '?' badges that cover them until the question is answered. 'records': original figures (assets/diagrams/nec/, written by tools/diagrams/build.py), per question. 'diagrams': scanned PDF crops listed in assets/diagrams/diagrams.json, per file (none ship: the three exam figures are redrawn). 'leaks' are the regions that would give the answer away; every leak must lie inside a mask. Rects are [x, y, w, h] as fractions of the image. See docs/DIAGRAMS_AUDIT.md.
